sentences.text: Ronald Keegan (Ron) is the person being assessed.
Lisa Keegan is Ronald's daughter.
The social worker, Tom Ashby, from the adult team at Coldmere, visited Ronald Keegan after a fall.
Ronald's wife, Pat, died in March.
Ronald fell in the kitchen after tripping on a mat.
Ronald has difficulty with stairs and goes up on his backside at night when he cannot use the stairs.
There is only one rail on the stairs.
Ronald cannot get into the bath since the fall.
Ronald uses microwave dinners and does not cook.
Lisa shops on Sundays for Ronald's meals.
Ronald has a history of drinking, consuming a couple of cans of lager with tea in the evening.
Lisa reports that Ronald drinks eight large cans of strong lager per day and has a bottle of vodka that is consumed in two days.
Lisa sees the empties of the cans and vodka in the bin every Sunday and counts them.
Ronald denies drinking excessively and says he is not drunk or hurting anyone.
Ronald is willing to have a home visit from the alcohol service for a 'chat' rather than a meeting.
Ronald agrees to consider a pendant alarm for fall detection.
The occupational therapist will assess the stairs and consider adding a second rail or perching stool.
A bathing assessment will be arranged by the occupational therapist.
Ronald says he would like to stay in his current home and does not want to move to a care home.
Ronald fell in the hall in the summer after drinking.
Mrs Okafor, next door, told Lisa that she has seen Ronald driving to the Co-op after drinking.
Ronald denies driving after drinking and says he only drives on Sundays to the cemetery.
Ronald earns approximately £1400 per month from state pension and works pension from the foundry.
Ronald does not currently receive Attendance Allowance.
Lisa is willing to help complete the Attendance Allowance form with Ronald.
The social worker will write to Dr Haines at Bridge Street surgery about the falls and alcohol consumption with Ronald's consent.
The social worker will refer Ronald to the alcohol service this week for a home visit.
The social worker will arrange a pendant alarm through Careline.
Lisa will complete the Attendance Allowance form with Ronald on Sunday.
The social worker will call Ronald on the 9th of December to check on his condition.
